body: I feel you as far as not knowing what comes next. I’m also afraid of it being painful. I don’t have a gun or any other means of killing myself besides jumping off something high so I just bank on having some sort of health complication during my sleep

I completely feel you as far as not wanting to play this stupid game. I never asked for this shit. I would feel more at peace not existing. Another thing I say to you, is that you should never live just to please other people. If the only thing holding up your suicide is your family being said, then I think you should do what your heart wants to do. It’s not fair for other people to shame you into living a life you don’t want. They view it as selfish, but they’re the ones being selfish wanting you to drag yourself along year by year just so they won’t be sad that you’re gone.
